title: The bar ladder that ends on a membership bar

aliases.name: R2 Bar ladder with a membership bar

members.role: the ladder: then against now as axis-less story bars (`axes: "none"`), each name in its category pill over its written value, the now bar the emphasised one (BUB 0:48-1:12)

options.tile: each member's index, on its name's word

members.role: the NOW bar fills with its members, one equal tile on each name's word (T45): who is in the one value, the total still written over it
the member the sentence names is lit and the bar's other tiles dim to E67's 0.45

does: Then against now as axis-less bars, each named in its pill over its written value; the now bar then fills with the equal tiles of who is in it, one on each name's word.

use_when.act: RANKS - then vs now, and the now bar is made of named members (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R2)
use_when.use: then vs now, and the "now" bar is made of named members (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN.md:209; BUB 01:24 'the total amount of AI related debt from just these few companies')
use_when.dont: the tiles carry values or differ in size, or the bar's total is unwritten (E99 s101; BRAVOS-USE-WHEN.md:210); an axis-less page with a value left unwritten (P71 T31: its values are its scale)

source: P71 T31 (harvest v2 R2 = T2 + A25 + T3): BUB 0:48-1:36 read off its frames (frame_0005-0008: the lone $3 trillion bar with its members' marks under it, then the ladder of pilled bars); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t31.py on H row 19's two clocks and T45's five-builders bar - no approved cut carries it
